feeds.title: My Scandinavian Home
feeds.description: Niki Brantmark, a Londoner residing in Sweden, shares her passion for Scandinavian interior design through her blog 'My Scandinavian Home.' With curated profiles of exotic Scandinavian homes, she inspires like-minded individuals with ethereal designs infused with vintage charm. As a published author, she continues to ignite creativity in her audience through her multiple books on the subject.

feeds.title: Trendenser
feeds.description: Frida Ramstedt, the creative force behind Trendenser.se, leads the Nordic region's interior design discourse. With daily updates brimming with inspiration, knowledge, and the latest trends, she elevates the art of home living. As the author of the bestselling 'Handbook in Interior Design and Styling,' her expertise resonates deeply, shaping the aesthetic sensibilities of countless enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Pretty Home Blog » Furnishing & Design
feeds.description: The Pretty Home Blog is a haven for home decor enthusiasts, delving into every facet of interior design, from furniture and lighting to colors and textiles. With a wealth of tips and ideas, it guides readers in crafting stylish living spaces, transforming each area of the home - from the living room and bedroom to the kitchen and bathroom - into a personalized haven of beauty and comfort.

feeds.title: Hemmafix Bloggen
feeds.description: Hemmafix, one of Sweden's premier interior design blogs, thrives on DIY projects, home fixes, and renovations. With a blend of creativity and resourcefulness, they transform everyday items into trendy furnishings, from flea market finds to Ikea hacks. Their diverse projects showcase ingenuity and inspire readers to unleash their own creativity in crafting unique and personalized living spaces.

feeds.title: True Deco
feeds.description: True Deco Inrednings blog is a delightful destination for interior design enthusiasts, offering a treasure trove of tips and insights. From the latest designs and market trends to industry news and decorating guidelines, it guides readers on a journey of style and inspiration. Join the journey and enrich your home decor knowledge with True Deco Inrednings.

feeds.title: Zahara Vintage Blog
feeds.description: Zahara Vintage Blog accompanies the renowned vintage clothing store, showcasing a curated selection of unique items spanning from the 1920s to the 1990s. Specializing in one-of-a-kind pieces sojewellerylobally, they offer vintage clothing, accessories, and vintage-inspired items. Their blog extends the passion for aesthetics, exploring home decor, design ideas, interior guides, trends, and industry updates, enriching the vintage lifestyle experience for all enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Hus & Hem
feeds.description: Hus and Hem, Sweden's foremost interior design magazine, captivates readers since 2008 with abundant inspiration and resources online. From stunning homes to insightful blogs and news, it's a haven for design enthusiasts. The Hus and Hem blog extends this wealth of inspiration, offering interior design ideas, homestead reports, gardening tips, and DIY guides, enriching the home decor journey for all who enter.

feeds.title: Hemma hos Helena
feeds.description: Welcome to 'Hemma hos Helena,' where Helena Sundström, marketing manager at Villa Varm, shares her passion for design, home decor, and gardening. Through her blog, crafted in her spare time as a hobby, she offers advice and inspiration fueled by her elegant, classic, and timeless style. With recommendations based on personal preference, she invites readers to discover the beauty of her curated world.

feeds.title: Design Studio 210
feeds.description: Design Studio 210 is a beacon of inspiration in the realm of interior design blogging. With a focus on the deeper meaning behind design, they illuminate the 'why' behind every concept. Through captivating narratives spanning interior spaces, design businesses, and people, they provoke thought, spark creativity, and foster meaningful discussions, enriching the design community with unique perspectives and ideas.

feeds.title: Eleish Van Breems Blog » Swedish Interiors
feeds.description: Eleish Van Breems Home is a beacon of Scandinavian design expertise, sharing insights, conversations, and ideas through their blog. Delve into the world of modern aesthetics, beautiful homes, and insider stories for a deeper understanding of Nordic design. EV Bantiques, their design and furnishings company, offers the finest in Scandinavian interior design, embodying the essence of timeless Nordic style.

feeds.title: Inredningshjälpen
feeds.description: Inredninghjälpen, a diligent and endlessly curious interior design blogger, celebrates sustainable design and personal style. With a keen eye for styling and trend scouting, they elevate everyday life with a touch of gold. Sharing insights on travel, food, and outdoor furniture, particularly from agencies representing Ethimo and French Home Spirit, they invite readers on a journey of exquisite taste and inspiration. Welcome to their world of design wonders!

feeds.title: Creativ Company Blog » Heminredning
feeds.description: Creative Company's Home Decor Blog is a haven for DIY enthusiasts, offering inspiration and tutorials for crafting handmade decor items. With a plethora of crafting techniques and materials, they empower readers to personalize their living spaces. From interviews with designers to product reviews, the blog covers diverse topics, enriching the home decor journey with creativity and insight.

feeds.title: Plaza Interior Magazine
feeds.description: Plaza Interiör, the go-to Swedish magazine for interior design and home decor enthusiasts, offers a wealth of inspiration and insights. From decorating ideas to furniture trends, it explores every aspect of home interiors. Through interviews with industry professionals and stylish home profiles, it enriches readers' understanding of design, elevating their homes with expert guidance and creativity.

feeds.title: Anna Truelsen
feeds.description: Meet Anna Truelsen, a multifaceted interior stylist, writer, and influencer. Since 2007, her blog has been a treasure trove of captivating content, spanning house renovations, interior and exterior photography, travel adventures, and magazine reports. Dive into her archive for a plethora of inspiring articles on interior design and home decor, curated with passion and expertise.
